thought.text: ddev runs as `ddevuser`. Now grant access to the workspace and check sudo.

reasoning_content:
ddev works as ddevuser. But the workspace is at /workspace owned by root. ddevuser needs access. Let me check permissions and give ddevuser ownership or access. Actually the guide says repository is checked out at /workspace. Let me chown to ddevuser, or work elsewhere. Better to make /workspace writable by ddevuser.

Also ddev requires global config. Let me try `ddev start` from /workspace as ddevuser.

First make sure /workspace is accessible. chown -R ddevuser /workspace might break things? It should be fine. Let me chown.

Also ddev needs mkcert setup, and /etc/hosts modifications. Let me check. Actually ddev start will need to write /etc/hosts for the ddev.site domain — it uses mkcert and hostname. Running as ddevuser with sudo? sudo may not be installed. Let me check.

Let's proceed.

action.command: which sudo || echo "no sudo"; chown -R ddevuser:ddevuser /workspace; su - ddevuser -c 'ls -la /workspace | head -5'; echo "--- hosts ---"; grep -i ddev /etc/hosts || echo "no ddev hosts entries"; cat /etc/resolv.conf | head
